name: Lina Gálvez - § 1, après le point b - Am 4
title: REPORT on a European Parliament recommendation to the Council concerning the EU priorities for the 70th session of the UN Commission on the Status of Women
part_text: (ba) recall that all human beings are born free and equal in dignity and rights and that everyone is entitled to rights and freedoms, without distinction of any kind on grounds such as race, sex, religion, opinion or sexual orientation;
